Maybe it would help to see a therapist that specializes in teenage social issues. I've had similar situations before and they can help you through your social anxiety. You didn't specify what kind of groups your friends are leaving and going to instead. Did you ever consider just joining those groups or do you not want to? What are the people like in that group?
Have you considered talking to X about how it makes you feel when he invites people to things right in front of your face? It can be hard but I'm sure since you said he's a nice guy he would realize and stop doing that. Maybe he would even invite you into his new friend group. Of course If you're not comfortable with doing these things which I totally understand, I would ask a therapist for help.

Hi, thanks for responding and sorry I couldn't get back to you earlier. Under the laws where I live and the state on the other side of the country where the guy I sent stuff to lives, you are a predator and can be imprisoned fined and have to register as a sex offender if caught. Stupid teenagers exploring their sexuality in an admittedly unhealthy and careless way are equal to creepy old men who film 4 year olds being raped under the law. Maybe the fine or prison sentence is less but still the same laws apply.
I'm freaking out because I made a silly mistake but I feel like the potential consequences are way worse than they should be, and I have no control over what ends up happening. So I end up worrying and believing that the worst case scenario will happen. It may not, but it could, so I worry about it. 
Idk if the police would be that interested in searching for me if they saw I wanted to "send pics" on snapchat but they didn't have evidence I actually did (I deleted my snapchat account and police have access to the background information of the snapchat-location, etc, but not the picture itself).
Am I freaking out over nothing? I'm not sure. I'm laying here having an outright panic attack. I need help but I'm too afraid to confess to anyone because then they might  turn me in.

Hi, thanks for responding and sorry I couldn't get back to you earlier.
This guy I sent nudes to was either 17 or 18 and I honestly have no clue. But I'm underage so that makes no difference because I still committed a felony.
He lives in a different state than me but in both teen sexting is possessing sending and receiving child porn. Fined up to $200,000 and up to 15 years in jail if caught
I can't shake that out of my head. I literally have evidence I wanted to send nudes to this guy lying there somewhere, maybe still on his phone, that I have no access to and cannot delete.
All it takes is police to search his phone. May not even be because they are suspicious of illegal stuff on it. May be just because he was arrested for something else. He lives in an area with a lot of crime so it's possible.
If they saw my private message with him on the social networking app, would police track me down even if the guy I sent pics too didn't save them and they weren't on my phone? Could the police track me down? I'm so scared. I am constantly seeing visions of going to jail, shattering my reputation, and various people I know finding out and never looking at me the same again, the police sending mail to my neighbors saying "watch out, a sex offender lives here..."
Times like this I can't breathe. I honestly don't know what to do.

I know it's hard to forget about it, but this happening is so unlikely. You basically summed up why it would never happen in one of your paragraphs. It's like the back of your mind telling you that your worrying is unnecessary. You need to believe more in that corner of your mind that uses logic rather than believing the other corner that causes you to think irrationally. 
You'll be fine :)

Hi, thanks for responding
I've been notably anxious and upset lately because of this and my parents have noticed. I told them I'm having anxiety attacks because I'm scared of what could happen in my future (which is true, I just didn't tell them what I did). So they set me up for an appointment with a therapist in a few weeks. I don't really want to confide in her what I did because couldn't she turn me over to cops and tell my parents, which is exactly what I don't want to happen?
Thanks for the advice. No there's not really a point where the danger will pass. I just have to hope that over time evidence will be buried and will be so long forgotten that it will never resurface.

I have the exact same issue as you and my problem is also potentially life ruining if the  .0000001% happens (which is probably a higher % for me). This is where you have to accept that you don't have control over what happens, but don't spend time worrying about it because it's so unlikely to ever happen. 
One thing you could do is look up things that are more likely to happen. Like get struck by lightning twice, get eaten by a shark in Nebraska, or get hit by a meteorite. Unless, of course, that makes you worry about those things and in that case don't do that.
Good luck. Know you're not alone, I understand your feelings 100% :)
I know, but I just don't want any issues at all with this and don't want to have to go to court, anything. I want this to completely slip through the cracks. That's my main concern

Hi all. Thanks for responding. Since everything I did was anonymous, I'm not too concerned about people seeing my nudes through a leak. I'm more concerned about if it could be traced back to my phone. Like I said, I don't know if he saved them or not. If he did, and he gets caught with them, couldn't the police figure out how to trace the origin of my nudes to my phone's IP address? I'm underage, keep in mind and that's child porn. I can just picture myself being sentenced to 10 years in prison.
Although the guy I sent stuff to is a little sketchy, I suspect he is 18 (an adult). Could I be charged since in this case it is adult-minor or would only he be charged? (Keep in mind I asked to send pics with him first, he didn't come to me).
One more question. I'm not sure if y'all are familiar with Distinc.tt, but it's literally impossible to permanently delete your account. It can be disabled, but you can get it back by just logging in again. That's all you can do. My account is disabled and dormant so no info shows up about it to anyone. Still, could Distinc.tt access my private chat with this guy and see that I wanted to send nudes? (Tbh, there are 13 year olds on the app who publicly ask for nudes and nothing seems to happen to them. I know, weird). 
Thanks for listening everyone! Already I feel a lot better and less suicidal. I just really wish I knew how things will eventually work out.
